wlf_narrative_canon.viewpoint_constraint: 3rd Person Limited (Strictly focused on Kaelen's psychological/sensory bounds). No omniscient leaks.
wlf_narrative_canon.thematic_friction_weight: 0.85 (Enforced Moral Ambiguity across all characters and factions).

character_nodes.Kaelen: The Vessel. Electric blue eyes flickering crimson. Marked on left forearm by grey-black spiderweb veins (Shadow's Mark) following Oakhaven Partial Dark Mode. Last scion of hereditary Heartstone Guardians.
character_nodes.Garrett Alerion: The Sentinel & Tactician. Wiry build, green eyes, left cheek scar. Zero magic capacity. Uses alchemical gadgetry (Wrist-Grapple, Burning Steel Oil) and twin Nightsteel blades. Grandson of disgraced Mathis Alerion.
character_nodes.Serafina: The Warden & Moral Compass. Slender build, blonde hair, warm green eyes. Armor of white plate with gold accents. Last descendant of the Lorekeepers. Magic operates on Transference (takes on physical/emotional pain of healing).
character_nodes.Valerius: The Dark Father. Elder of the White Flame, secret leader of the Cult of Nyx. Seeking Redemption through Control to fix Eldrin's failure. Uses Hand of Light gauntlet as a golden leash/suppression trap.
character_nodes.Eldrin: The Prisoner in the Blade. Fallen Paladin of unparallelled renown. Sealed within Oathbringer during the Calamity at Kaelen's Hamlet (Black Op gone wrong, parent deaths were collateral damage).

oathbringer_morphology.base_state: Nightsteel longsword, wolf-head pommel, garnet eyes deep red, containable dark stain expanding from crossguard. Emits low-frequency thrum.
oathbringer_morphology.light_mode: Stain recedes, blade gleams white-gold, runes glow silver-blue, pommel eyes turn white/blue, thrum clarifies into a harmonious, resonant chord. Triggers Smite and Beacon of Hope.
oathbringer_morphology.dark_mode: Stain aggressively consumes blade emitting oily smoke, pommel eyes burn intense crimson, runes writhe in purple/red light, metal feels freezing cold. Sword expands into a massive greatsword. Triggers Shadow Step, Corrupted Blow, and Nyx's Grasp.

temporal_narrative_map.PNR_0: The Calamity at Kaelen's Hamlet. Eldrin ritual implodes. Guardian parents killed. Oathbringer acquired.
temporal_narrative_map.PNR_1: The Incident at the Silent Spire. Kaelen touches partial Dark Mode to save Garrett. Serafina executes Transference. Order covers up event as training accident. Creates the 'Code of Silence' and the 'Support Triangle' (Trinity Strike, Aegis of the Faithful, Warden's Tempest, Shepherd's Gambit).
temporal_narrative_map.PNR_2: The Tragedy at Oakhaven. Kaelen willingly accepts Partial Dark Mode to save Elara from the Shepherd. Branded with the Shadow's Mark. Valerius hijacks narrative to frame it as a 'costly victory.'
temporal_narrative_map.PNR_3: The Revelation of the Sacrifice. Discovery of the Order's Great Lie: Paragons do not ascend; they are used as biological prisons for the Living Seal. Kaelen's inevitable doom vs. Act III quest for the Secret Outcome (Kaelen-Eldrin Fusion/Synthesis).
